audit.whatIsWrong: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 read Skill while whys[3] says 'you stack W procs and out-trade him with remount sustain every short trade' and whys[4] says 'commit hard whenever his ult is down'; 2+ items read Kled while whys[6] says he scales into an AP-immune frontline and tells you to close before two items. The packet chart is Skill/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill.
audit.why: Three rows rendered a side token their own why-line argues against, and the packet agrees with the prose on all three.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 and Level 6 to Kled, 2+ items to Skill, as matched pairs in both layers; Levels 4-5 rating to 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Unstoppable Force was described only as 'saved for fights, lane is fine without it' — no cooldown anywhere, so 'commit when it's down' had no duration attached.
audit.why: Unstoppable Force is 130/115/100s. Seismic Shard is a flat 8s, Ground Slam a flat 7s, Thunderclap 10/9.5/9/8.5/8s. Kled's Jousting is 13s at rank 1 and CHAAAARGE 140s.
audit.corrected: The 130s ultimate, the 7s Ground Slam and the 13s Jousting written into the cooldown block, the phase rows and the Do's/Don'ts.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two things. (a) The page never mentioned that Seismic Shard and Ground Slam both apply grounding — they shut off Jousting AND CHAAAARGE, which is the single most important interaction in this lane and appeared in zero strings. (b) Six strings claim Bear Trap deals 'percent-max-HP' damage; Riot's text says only 'additional physical damage' when the shackle completes. There is no percent component anywhere in Kled's kit.
audit.why: A reader told his Q shreds a tank through armour will build and trade around a damage type that does not exist, and will dash into a grounding zone expecting to dash back out. The mirror auditor found and removed the same percent claim from the Malphite side.
audit.corrected: Grounding written into the interactions row, the cooldown block and the Level 3 why; the percent-HP claim replaced with the real mechanism — the shackle bonus and Violent Tendencies' four on-hit attacks — in whys[2], whys[5], spikes[2].text, wants.you[0] and wants.you[1]. Thunderclap's auto-reset tell added.
sources: kit file malphite Q, W, E

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Unstoppable Force's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Stack Violent Tendencies procs and out-trade with remount sustain — his single Seismic Shard every 8s cannot answer on-hit burst.

edits.before: CHAAAARGE turns any side wave into a cross-map gank. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Malphite's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: CHAAAARGE is your re-engage, not a duel tool; his Unstoppable Force is 130s, so commit hard the moment he spends it.

edits.before: Track Malphite's Unstoppable Force: Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. When it is down — Q-pull + W him.
edits.after: Seismic Shard (8s) and Ground Slam (7s) both GROUND you — neither Jousting nor CHAAAARGE works inside them.

edits.before: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Malphite Unstoppable Force: matchup-defining — 130s at rank 1, saved for fights. Commit the moment it is spent. - Ground Slam: 7s, and it grounds both your dashes. - Your Bear Trap: free, 11s at 800 range.

edits.before: Saved for fights. Lane is fine without it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: 130s at rank 1, saved for fights — commit the whole pattern once it is spent.

edits.before: That is Malphite's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Thunderclap is an auto reset — his wind-up is your cue to step out, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Jousting is 13s at rank 1 — don't spend it into a grounding zone.

edits.before: With Q plus E plus W you land the full re-E all-in, and your percent-max-HP Q shreds him while his armor stacking is irrelevant.
edits.after: With Q plus E plus W you land the full re-E all-in — but Ground Slam (7s) grounds the dash, so land the trap first, then commit.

edits.before: Eclipse or Trinity sheen proc plus percent-HP Q on a low-MR armor tank is your power peak — force every all-in here.
edits.after: Eclipse sheen procs plus Violent Tendencies' four-attack burst beat a low-MR armour tank — force every all-in here.

edits.before: Eclipse or Trinity sheen proc plus your percent-max-HP Q on a low-MR armor tank is your peak — force every short trade here.
edits.after: Eclipse or Trinity sheen proc plus Violent Tendencies' four attacks on a low-MR armour tank is your peak — force short trades.

edits.before: Land Bear Trap on a Rope for the percent-max-HP damage and slow, then yank in for the W on-hit shotgun all-in
edits.after: Land Bear Trap on a Rope for the slow and the shackle bonus, then yank in for the W on-hit shotgun all-in

edits.before: Reach level 2-3 and burst him with the re-E plus W procs while his armor does nothing against your percent-HP Q
edits.after: Reach level 2-3 and burst him with the re-E plus W on-hit procs, which his armour stacking barely blunts

notes: Biggest finding in this slice: NEITHER layer mentioned that Seismic Shard and Ground Slam ground Kled — they deny Jousting and CHAAAARGE both, which changes every engage in the lane. Also removed the fabricated 'percent-max-HP Q' claim from five strings; Riot's Bear Trap text says 'additional physical damage' with no percent component, and the mirror auditor removed the same claim from the Malphite side. The same false claim still survives in early, mid and late (long prose blocks) — a follow-up pass should clear those three. CAUTION: the mirror (malphite__kled) was audited but its findings list four point-4 entries and NO point-2 entry, so I could not see what chart it asserts. I followed the packet and this page's own whys; if the mirror's chart differs at Levels 4-5, Level 6 or 2+ items, mirror-fix.js will need to reconcile them.
